docs.title: Cardiovascular Disease Classification
docs.text:
Classify the presence of cardiovascular disease at medical examination from the Sulianova dataset's 11 features. LightGBM is the main estimator; RandomForest with median imputation is the baseline. The historical repository name is retained.

Model and weights · Evaluation protocol · Русский

docs.title: Current artifact and evaluation
docs.text:
Replayed on the original 10501-row test fold, legacy seed42 protocol

Metric Value LightGBM ROC-AUC 79.77% LightGBM average precision 78.11% RF ROC-AUC 79.49% RF average precision 77.94%

Target is CVD presence at examination. The exact legacy split is 48999/10500/10501; original training row membership is unrecorded. Average precision uses sklearn AP.

Evaluation record · Pinned model

The source CSV, exact row split, model hashes and prediction arrays accompany the new replay. Average precision is the sklearn AP measure; thresholds use 0.5. This is a retrospective research classifier, with no prospective ten-year horizon or clinical validation.

docs.title: Data, artifacts and replay contract
docs.text: The released files were inspected after SHA256 verification. Both are dict bundles with model, best_params, cv_pr_auc. The main Pipeline contains LGBMClassifier; the RF Pipeline contains median imputation and RandomForestClassifier. Both expose the same 11 input features, and the RF records 48,999 training rows.

docs.title: Exact source and split
docs.text:
The original Sulianova CSV is SHA256 21a705d23381b0dfd6a6416da701b490744f1fc3b47e9ff3db3968c420ffa10c, extracted from archive SHA256 b78ff607480810c3e27de3e11d52c4962a3a81dbb3d69365e1cf3394a67c2b23 (dataset 107706/version256873).

The seed 42 stratified protocol requests 70/15/15 via float test sizes. Sklearn's ceiling gives 48,999/10,500/10,501 rows. This matches the saved RF's training count. The recovered recipe and source order are recorded; historical checkpoint training row IDs themselves remain unrecorded.

Source receipt · Exact row split · Replay.

docs.title: Inputs and target
docs.text:
age, gender, height, weight, ap_hi, ap_lo, cholesterol, gluc, smoke, alco, active.

Age is rounded years after dividing source days by 365.25. Height is cm, weight kg, blood pressures mmHg. Other codes retain source encoding: gender 1/2; cholesterol/glucose 1/2/3; smoking/alcohol/activity 0/1. The model's binary class 1 is the source cardio label at medical examination. No prospective time horizon is attached.

The evaluator reports ROC-AUC, sklearn average precision (the legacy pr_auc key), F1/Brier and confusion counts at threshold 0.5. Main and RF use the same reconstructed test rows. Results describe this cohort; they are not a clinical validation or a causal feature analysis.

docs.title: Model file formats
docs.text:
Canonical cardio_risk_lgbm.joblib and cardio_risk_rf.joblib preserve their original bytes. sklearn_model.joblib is an explicit plain-Pipeline alias of the main estimator, with separate SHA256 and prediction-parity evidence. Payload contract · Alias verification.

The alias serialization matches the canonical model on every 10,501 test row, with zero probability difference. It does not create a second trained model. The source dataset license is Unknown in publisher metadata; code MIT is a separate component declaration.

The runner checks CSV and model hashes, records source/package identities and stores anonymized probability/target arrays. docs.title: cardio
docs.text:
sulianova Cardiovascular Disease dataset loader + stratified split.

Canonical main-pipeline dataset for cardio-risk-rf. 70000 patients, binary target cardio at ~50/50 positive rate. See https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/sulianova/cardiovascular-disease-dataset

Raw columns (source CSV): id;age;gender;height;weight;ap_hi;ap_lo;cholesterol;gluc;smoke;alco;active;cardio

  • id is dropped on load.
  • age is converted from days (18000-23000) to integer years (32-65) during load so downstream pipelines, SHAP plots, and the serving API all work in a human-readable unit.
  • gender is left as 1/2 (source encoding) - LightGBM and RandomForest treat it as a numeric feature without issue.
  • cholesterol and gluc are ordinal (1=normal, 2=above normal, 3=well above normal); kept as numeric for trees.
  • smoke, alco, active are binary 0/1.
  • ap_hi/ap_lo are systolic/diastolic BP (mmHg).
  • Target cardio is 0 (no CVD) / 1 (CVD).

docs.title: load_cardio
docs.text:
load_cardio(csv_path: str | Path) -> pd.DataFrame

Read the sulianova Cardiovascular Disease CSV.

The source file is ;-separated; some Kaggle forks reshuffle to , - both are auto-detected. id is dropped. age is converted from days to integer years. Column order is stabilised to FEATURES + [TARGET].

Source code in src/cardio_risk_rf/data/cardio.py 
def load_cardio(csv_path: str | Path) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Read the sulianova Cardiovascular Disease CSV.

    The source file is `;`-separated; some Kaggle forks reshuffle to `,` -
    both are auto-detected. `id` is dropped. `age` is converted from days
    to integer years. Column order is stabilised to FEATURES + [TARGET].
    """
    path = Path(csv_path)
    with path.open("r", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
        first_line = fh.readline()
    sep = ";" if first_line.count(";") > first_line.count(",") else ","
    df = pd.read_csv(path, sep=sep)

    if "id" in df.columns:
        df = df.drop(columns=["id"])

    missing = {TARGET, *FEATURES} - set(df.columns)
    if missing:
        raise ValueError(f"sulianova CSV missing columns: {sorted(missing)}")

    df["age"] = (df["age"] / 365.25).round().astype("int64")
    df = df[[*FEATURES, TARGET]].copy()
    df[TARGET] = df[TARGET].astype("int64")
    return df

def split_stratified(
    df: pd.DataFrame,
    *,
    seed: int = 42,
    train_ratio: float = 0.70,
    val_ratio: float = 0.15,
) -> tuple[pd.DataFrame, pd.DataFrame, pd.DataFrame]:
    """Return (train, val, test) with stratification on the target column."""
    if not 0 < train_ratio < 1:
        raise ValueError(f"train_ratio out of range: {train_ratio}")
    if not 0 < val_ratio < 1 - train_ratio:
        raise ValueError(f"val_ratio out of range: {val_ratio}")
    test_ratio = 1.0 - train_ratio - val_ratio

    train_df, rest = train_test_split(
        df,
        test_size=1 - train_ratio,
        stratify=df[TARGET],
        random_state=seed,
    )
    val_df, test_df = train_test_split(
        rest,
        test_size=test_ratio / (val_ratio + test_ratio),
        stratify=rest[TARGET],
        random_state=seed,
    )
    return (
        train_df.reset_index(drop=True),
        val_df.reset_index(drop=True),
        test_df.reset_index(drop=True),
    )

Prepare exact legacy split membership without mixing existing destination files.

Source code in src/cardio_risk_rf/data/prepare.py 
def prepare_dataset(raw: Path, out: Path, seed: int = 42) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Prepare exact legacy split membership without mixing existing destination files."""
    if out.exists() and any(p.name != ".gitkeep" for p in out.iterdir()):
        raise ValueError("Processed destination must be empty; existing files are preserved")
    df = load_cardio(raw)
    df["_source_row"] = range(len(df))
    train_df, val_df, test_df = split_stratified(df, seed=seed)
    frames = {"train": train_df, "val": val_df, "test": test_df}
    rows = {name: frame["_source_row"].astype(int).tolist() for name, frame in frames.items()}
    serialized = json.dumps(rows, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":")) + "\n"
    with raw.open("rb") as stream:
        csv_sha256 = hashlib.file_digest(stream, "sha256").hexdigest()
    manifest = {
        "schema_version": 1,
        "seed": seed,
        "source_csv_sha256": csv_sha256,
        "protocol": "legacy sklearn float test_size ceil; requested 70/15/15",
        "sizes": {name: len(frame) for name, frame in frames.items()},
        "age_transform": "round(source_days / 365.25) integer years",
        "records_sha256": hashlib.sha256(serialized.encode()).hexdigest(),
        "splits": rows,
    }
    out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    for name, frame in frames.items():
        frame.drop(columns=["_source_row"]).to_parquet(out / f"{name}.parquet", index=False)
    (out / "split-manifest.json").write_text(
        json.dumps(manifest, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8", newline="\n"
    )
    print(f"Prepared source={csv_sha256}, sizes={manifest['sizes']}")
    return manifest

def build_baseline(
    *,
    random_state: int = 42,
    **rf_overrides: Any,
) -> Pipeline:
    """RandomForest baseline; median imputation because RF cannot split on NaN."""
    params: dict[str, Any] = {
        "n_estimators": 500,
        "max_depth": None,
        "min_samples_split": 2,
        "min_samples_leaf": 1,
        "max_features": "sqrt",
        "class_weight": "balanced",
        "random_state": random_state,
        "n_jobs": -1,
    }
    params.update(rf_overrides)
    return Pipeline(
        steps=[
            ("imputer", SimpleImputer(strategy="median")),
            ("clf", RandomForestClassifier(**params)),
        ]
    )

def build_pipeline(model_name: str = "lgbm", **model_params: Any) -> Pipeline:
    """Build an sklearn Pipeline by model name."""
    if model_name == "lgbm":
        clf = lgb.LGBMClassifier(random_state=42, **model_params)
    elif model_name == "random_forest":
        clf = RandomForestClassifier(random_state=42, **model_params)
    else:
        raise ValueError(f"Unknown model: {model_name}")
    return Pipeline([("scaler", StandardScaler()), ("clf", clf)])

def save_calibration_plot(
    y_true: np.ndarray,
    probs: np.ndarray,
    out_path: str | Path,
    *,
    bins: int = 10,
    title: str = "Calibration curve",
) -> None:
    """Write a reliability-diagram PNG."""
    frac_pos, mean_pred = calibration_curve(y_true, probs, n_bins=bins, strategy="quantile")
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(5, 5), dpi=120)
    ax.plot([0, 1], [0, 1], linestyle="--", color="gray", label="Perfect")
    ax.plot(mean_pred, frac_pos, marker="o", linewidth=2, label="Model")
    ax.set_xlabel("Predicted probability")
    ax.set_ylabel("Observed positive rate")
    ax.set_title(title)
    ax.set_xlim(0.0, 1.0)
    ax.set_ylim(0.0, 1.0)
    ax.legend(loc="lower right")
    ax.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
    fig.tight_layout()
    out_path = Path(out_path)
    out_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    fig.savefig(out_path)
    plt.close(fig)

def compute_metrics(
    y_true: np.ndarray,
    probs: np.ndarray,
    *,
    threshold: float = 0.5,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Return a flat dict with ROC-AUC / PR-AUC / F1 / Brier for reporting."""
    y_true = np.asarray(y_true).astype(int)
    probs = np.asarray(probs).astype(float)
    if y_true.shape != probs.shape:
        raise ValueError(f"shape mismatch: {y_true.shape} vs {probs.shape}")
    if y_true.size == 0:
        raise ValueError("empty y_true")

    preds = (probs >= threshold).astype(int)
    return {
        "roc_auc": float(roc_auc_score(y_true, probs)),
        "pr_auc": float(average_precision_score(y_true, probs)),
        "f1": float(f1_score(y_true, preds)),
        "brier": float(brier_score_loss(y_true, probs)),
        "threshold": float(threshold),
        "n": int(y_true.size),
        "positive_rate": float(y_true.mean()),
    }

def predict(model: Any, features: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Run inference on a single feature mapping and return pred + class probabilities."""
    import pandas as pd

    unknown = set(features) - set(FEATURES)
    if unknown:
        raise ValueError(f"Unknown cardio features: {sorted(unknown)}")
    if not any(value is not None for value in features.values()):
        raise ValueError("At least one feature is required")
    if features.get("age") is not None and not 0 <= float(features["age"]) <= 120:
        raise ValueError("Model age is in rounded years, not source days")
    x = pd.DataFrame([{name: features.get(name) for name in FEATURES}]).astype(float)
    proba = model.predict_proba(x)[0].tolist()
    pred = int(model.predict(x)[0])
    return {"pred": pred, "proba": proba}

def main() -> None:
    """CLI entry point - parse args, load model, predict, print JSON."""
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--model", "--checkpoint", dest="checkpoint", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--input", required=True, help="JSON object or path to a JSON feature file")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    configure_logging()
    model = load_model(args.checkpoint)
    text = (
        args.input if args.input.lstrip().startswith("{") else Path(args.input).read_text("utf-8")
    )
    features = json.loads(text)
    if not isinstance(features, dict):
        raise ValueError("Input must be a JSON object of cardio features")
    result = predict(model, features)
    print(json.dumps(result, indent=2))

async def lifespan(app: FastAPI) -> AsyncIterator[None]:
    """FastAPI lifespan - eagerly load the model (best-effort) on startup."""
    configure_logging(json_output=True)
    try:

        log.info("startup.model_loaded")

@app.middleware("http")
async def add_request_id(
    request: Request, call_next: Callable[[Request], Awaitable[Response]]
) -> Response:
    """Middleware - inject a UUID request id and echo it back as `X-Request-ID`."""
    request.state.request_id = str(uuid.uuid4())
    response = await call_next(request)
    response.headers["X-Request-ID"] = request.state.request_id
    return response

def configure_logging(level: str = "INFO", json_output: bool = False) -> None:
    """Initialise stdlib + structlog with JSON or console rendering."""
    logging.basicConfig(format="%(message)s", stream=sys.stdout, level=level.upper())
    processors: list[Any] = [
        structlog.contextvars.merge_contextvars,
        structlog.stdlib.add_log_level,
        structlog.processors.TimeStamper(fmt="iso"),
        structlog.processors.StackInfoRenderer(),
    ]
    if json_output:
        processors.append(structlog.processors.JSONRenderer())
    else:
        processors.append(structlog.dev.ConsoleRenderer())
    structlog.configure(
        processors=processors,
        wrapper_class=structlog.make_filtering_bound_logger(getattr(logging, level.upper())),
        context_class=dict,
        logger_factory=structlog.PrintLoggerFactory(),
        cache_logger_on_first_use=True,
    )

def get_logger(name: str | None = None) -> structlog.stdlib.BoundLogger:
    """Return a structlog bound logger; call after `configure_logging`."""
    logger: structlog.stdlib.BoundLogger = structlog.get_logger(name)
    return logger

def seed_everything(seed: int = 42) -> None:
    """Seed Python, NumPy, and (optionally) PyTorch for deterministic behaviour."""
    random.seed(seed)
    np.random.seed(seed)
    os.environ["PYTHONHASHSEED"] = str(seed)
    try:
        import torch  # type: ignore[import-not-found]  # template stub; revisit in backport

        torch.manual_seed(seed)
        torch.cuda.manual_seed_all(seed)
        torch.backends.cudnn.deterministic = True
    except ImportError:
        pass

docs.title: Architecture
docs.text:
Two independent sklearn.Pipeline artefacts sharing the same {prob, class, shap_top5} contract.

flowchart LR
  CSV[Sulianova cardio CSV]:::external --> Prep[prepare.py<br/>70/15/15 stratified]:::code
  Prep --> Train[train.parquet]:::data
  Prep --> Val[val.parquet]:::data
  Prep --> Test[test.parquet]:::data
  Train --> LGBM[LightGBM<br/>+ Optuna 50]:::model
  Train --> RF[RandomForest<br/>+ GridSearchCV]:::model
  Val --> LGBM
  Val --> Calib[Calibration plot]:::artifact
  LGBM --> MainArt[artifacts/main/*.joblib]:::artifact
  RF --> BaseArt[artifacts/baseline/*.joblib]:::artifact
  MainArt --> API[FastAPI /predict]:::serve
  BaseArt --> API
  MainArt --> SHAP[Global SHAP<br/>reports/*]:::serve
  Test --> Score[compute_metrics]:::code
  MainArt --> Score
  BaseArt --> Score

  classDef external fill:#FFEBEE,stroke:#E53935,color:#B71C1C
  classDef data fill:#FFCDD2,stroke:#E53935,color:#B71C1C
  classDef code fill:#EF9A9A,stroke:#C62828,color:#B71C1C
  classDef model fill:#EF5350,stroke:#B71C1C,color:#fff
  classDef artifact fill:#E53935,stroke:#B71C1C,color:#fff
  classDef serve fill:#C62828,stroke:#B71C1C,color:#fff

Key design decisions: - Main model uses LightGBM native NaN handling - no imputer in its pipeline. Missing values at inference (including /predict) are forwarded as-is. - Baseline uses SimpleImputer(strategy="median") because RandomForest cannot split on NaN. No StandardScaler (tree models are scale-invariant). - Class imbalance handled by scale_pos_weight = N_neg / N_pos (LGBM) and class_weight="balanced" (RF). - Hyperparameter search: Optuna 50 trials for LGBM (TPE sampler, seed=42, early-stopping on val), GridSearchCV short grid for RF. - Final metric table uses test set only; calibration plot uses val to avoid test-set contamination.

docs.title: Serving the released models
docs.text: The API consumes the 11-feature Sulianova schema. age is rounded years; the response score refers to cardio=1 at medical examination.

docs.title: Install model files
docs.text:
Use the exact pinned/checksummed bundles described in the README. The default paths are:

  • artifacts/main/cardio_risk_lgbm.joblib
  • artifacts/baseline/cardio_risk_rf.joblib

CARDIO_MAIN_CKPT and CARDIO_BASELINE_CKPT can point to already-cached verified files. They are operator-controlled paths, not upload fields. Bundles and plain Pipelines are accepted.

uv run --frozen uvicorn cardio_risk_rf.serving.main:app --port 8000
curl -X POST http://127.0.0.1:8000/predict \
  -H 'content-type: application/json' -d @data/widget/sample_patient.json

Append ?model=baseline to compare the RF estimator. Inputs are age,gender,height,weight,ap_hi,ap_lo,cholesterol,gluc,smoke,alco,active; field descriptions and range validation live in serving/schemas.py. Null values use the fitted model's missing-value handling; an all-null record returns 422.

docs.title: Response
docs.text: The JSON contains probability, class, threshold, shap_top5, model_version, model_name, and request_id. CARDIO_MODEL_VERSION identifies the deployed artifact; CARDIO_THRESHOLD defaults to 0.5. SHAP contributions describe fitted-model associations and retain their explainer output scale; they are not causal effects or clinical recommendations.

docs.title: Container
docs.text:
docker compose up api mounts ./artifacts:/app/artifacts:ro. Weights are not in the image. Prepare or download the reviewed model files before launch; a successful build alone does not establish inference availability. The service runs on port 8000.

The training target is cross-sectional. The retained Framingham loader/legacy notes do not define this API's released model contract.

docs.title: Training
docs.text:
The actual orchestrator is scripts/train_all.py. It trains the LightGBM main estimator with 50 Optuna trials and a RandomForest grid with 5-fold CV, using seed 42. Checkpoints are joblib bundles under artifacts/main and artifacts/baseline.

uv run --frozen python scripts/fetch_data.py
uv run --frozen python -m cardio_risk_rf.data.prepare --raw data/raw/cardio.csv --out data/processed
uv run --frozen python scripts/train_all.py

These commands create a new run. For reproducing published weights' evaluation, use the inference-only replay. The scaffold Hydra configuration files are retained for reference; the orchestrator's explicit parameters govern its current behavior.

docs.text: Historical material. The currently released 11-feature weights use Sulianova/cardio. See the current evaluation contract.

docs.title: Legacy dataset
docs.text:
original_dataset.csv is the 49-row cardiovascular-biomarker table shipped with the original coro-detect repository by the same author, with Cyrillic column names (болезнь, Возраст, Лейкоциты, КДО, склеростин, WIF-1, GSK-3α).

It is preserved here for provenance. Earlier notes referred to a Framingham prototype. The currently published 11-feature models instead use Sulianova/cardio, as documented in the current evaluation contract.

To replay the original on the new pipeline for a demo, see notebooks/02_demo.ipynb.
